## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior, with a before/after example when useful.

## Validation

List checks actually run, results and flows not verified.

## Continuity checklist

- [ ] Updated `README.md` for application/configuration/workflow changes.
- [ ] Kept capabilities, source map, calculations, data contracts, setup and known issues consistent with final code.
- [ ] Recorded implementation/validation and refreshed reviewed source baseline when runtime behavior changed.
- [ ] Preserved profile/history/food data and documented migration impact.
- [ ] Distinguished requested, implemented, built, deployed and end-to-end verified states.
- [ ] Used synthetic examples; no private exports or credentials included.

## Remaining limits

List unresolved issues, external setup or follow-up verification, or write `None`.
